name: io.rugmunch/pry
title: Pry — Web Scraping, Browser Automation & Data Intelligence MCP
description: Self-hosted web intelligence platform: scrape, crawl, extract, automate, and parse any website, plus ten data domains (crypto, marketplace, legal, real estate, jobs, travel, attention, local, gov, ip) monetized via x402 pay-per-call. Exposed as a Model Context Protocol server.

transports.description: Run the MCP server locally over stdio (console script from the pypi:pryscraper-mcp distribution)

tools.name: pry_scrape
tools.description: Scrape a URL to clean markdown with 9-tier anti-bot bypass

tools.name: pry_crawl
tools.description: Crawl a website from a starting URL up to max_pages

tools.name: pry_extract
tools.description: Extract structured data with CSS selectors
